channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Tamil Nadu Employees Call Off Strike as CM Stalin Announces Assured Pension Scheme
item.description: The Tamil Nadu government introduced an assured pension scheme after talks with unions, prompting employees to withdraw their planned indefinite strike.

item.title: US Attacks Venezuela: What We Know So Far About Maduro’s Arrest and Trump’s Claim of Control
item.description: A sudden US military operation led to Nicolás Maduro’s arrest, triggering global backlash, legal questions, and uncertainty over Venezuela’s future.

item.title: Amul Flags Illegal US Imports of Indian Cow Ghee Mislabelled as Vegetable Oil to Evade Duty
item.description: Amul alleges Indian-market ghee is being misdeclared as vegetable or puja oil in the US to dodge high import duties.

item.title: Trump Threatens Higher Tariffs as India Weighs Russian Oil Imports Against US Trade
item.description: Trump threatens India with steeper tariffs unless New Delhi halts Russian oil imports to "make him happy."

item.title: Bangladesh Pre-Poll Violence: Hindu Youth Shot Dead in Jessore, Fifth Minority Attack in Three Weeks
item.description: The killing of a Hindu youth in Jessore has intensified fears over minority safety and law and order ahead of Bangladesh’s national elections.

item.title: Gunfire and Drone Fears Grip Caracas After Maduro’s US Court Appearance Sparks Confusion Near Presidential Palace
item.description: Gunfire near Venezuela’s presidential palace followed Nicolás Maduro’s US capture, later traced to security confusion, not escalation.

item.title: “Speak Kannada at Your Home”: AMC College Warden’s Alleged Threat Goes Viral, Triggers Protests; Arrested and Suspended
item.description: A hostel warden’s alleged remarks restricting Kannada use on campus sparked protests, police action, and renewed debate on language, power, and inclusivity in educational spaces.

item.title: Venezuela Defense Minister Warns World of “Dangerous Precedent” Following Maduro’s Arrest by US Forces
item.description: Venezuela’s Defense Minister warns the world that the "cowardly kidnapping" of Maduro sets a dangerous global precedent.

item.title: A Child Born After Ten Years Dies as Sewage-Contaminated Water Exposes Indore’s Public Health Failure
item.description: A contaminated municipal water supply in Indore has triggered a deadly outbreak, exposing grave urban infrastructure failures.

item.title: Somiphos Under Scrutiny For Relationship With Crime Kingpin Amit Gupta Of Agrifields DMCC
item.description: Leaked banking records and emails suggest systematic bribery that enabled deeply discounted phosphate deals with Algeria’s state-owned Somiphos over nearly two decades.
